He said drop her or we're done as partners.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a business partner who gave him an ultimatum over the woman he was dating. Unless he ended it, one of them was buying the other out.

Kevin wasn't sure she was the one for life. But he didn't like being told who he could date, so he chose to walk away from the business.

Sometimes the right choice costs you something real.

When did you last refuse to be told what to do in your own life?

#ad #love #business #kevintrudeau

Ten years. He was shocked. Then he chose how to see it.

Kevin Trudeau tells of being charged with contempt of court, which he points out is not even a crime, and handed the longest sentence ever given for it.

He sat there stunned. Then he said one thing to himself: adversity is a gift.

He admits he didn't know why it was a gift. He decided to believe it anyway.

What hard moment in your life could you decide to call a gift?
